a1b2c3d4.name: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio
steps: Boil salted water, cook spaghetti al dente
Meanwhile, heat olive oil on low, add garlic and chili flakes; cook until garlic is golden (don't burn)
Reserve 1 cup pasta water, drain pasta
Toss pasta in the oil with a splash of pasta water until glossy
Stir in parsley, season, serve with parmesan
a1b2c3d4.notes: Classic 4-ingredient Italian. Don't brown the garlic.

b2c3d4e5.name: Thai Green Curry
steps: Simmer half the coconut milk until oil separates
Fry curry paste in the oil 2 min
Add chicken, cook 5 min
Add rest of coconut milk, veg, lime leaves
Simmer 15 min until chicken tender
Season with fish sauce and sugar, top with basil
b2c3d4e5.notes: Substitute tofu for a vegetarian version.

c3d4e5f6.name: Shakshuka
steps: Sauté onion and pepper until soft, 8 min
Add garlic and spices, cook 1 min
Pour in tomatoes, simmer 10 min until thickened
Make 4 wells, crack eggs in
Cover, cook 6-8 min until whites set
Top with feta and parsley
c3d4e5f6.notes: Great any time of day. Serve with crusty bread.

d4e5f6g7.name: Classic Burger
steps: Form 4 loose patties, thumb-dent the middle
Season generously with salt and pepper
Get pan ripping hot, cook patties 3 min per side
Add cheese last minute, cover to melt
Toast buns, assemble with toppings
d4e5f6g7.notes: Don't press the patty while cooking.

e5f6g7h8.name: Chicken Tikka Masala
steps: Marinate chicken in yogurt, half the spices, 30 min min
Grill or pan-sear chicken until charred
Sauté onion, garlic, ginger with remaining spices
Add tomatoes, simmer 10 min, blend smooth
Stir in cream and chicken, simmer 10 min
Serve with rice and naan

f6g7h8i9.name: Caesar Salad
ingredients: For dressing: 2 anchovies, 1 garlic, 1 egg yolk, 1 tsp Dijon, 1 tbsp lemon juice, 4 tbsp olive oil
steps: Cube bread, toss in oil, bake 180°C 10 min for croutons
Whisk dressing: mash anchovies and garlic, whisk in yolk, mustard, lemon, then drizzle in oil
Toss romaine with dressing, top with croutons and shaved parmesan
f6g7h8i9.notes: Add grilled chicken to make it a main.

g7h8i9j0.name: Miso Ramen
steps: Heat stock, whisk in miso and soy
Cook noodles per package, drain
Ladle broth into bowls over noodles
Top with sliced meat, egg, spring onion, nori
g7h8i9j0.notes: Cheat-version, real ramen broth takes hours.

h8i9j0k1.name: Margherita Pizza
steps: Mix flour, yeast, salt, water; knead 10 min, rise 1 hr
Divide into 4, rest 30 min
Crush tomatoes with salt
Stretch dough, top with sauce, torn mozzarella
Bake 250°C (max oven) on pizza stone/steel 6-8 min
Finish with basil and olive oil
h8i9j0k1.notes: Dough is better after 24h cold ferment.

i9j0k1l2.name: Pad Thai
steps: Soak noodles in hot water 10 min until flexible
Mix sauce: tamarind, fish sauce, sugar
Stir-fry shrimp in wok 2 min, push aside, scramble eggs
Add noodles and sauce, toss 2 min
Add sprouts and spring onions, toss 30 sec
Serve with peanuts, lime, chili
i9j0k1l2.notes: Have everything prepped — stir-fry goes fast.

j0k1l2m3.name: Greek Salad
steps: Chop tomatoes into wedges, cucumber chunks, onion thin
Combine with olives
Top with slab of feta (not crumbled!)
Drizzle olive oil, sprinkle oregano and salt
j0k1l2m3.notes: Feta goes on TOP, not mixed in. No lettuce.

k1l2m3n4.name: Beef Bourguignon
steps: Brown bacon, remove. Sear beef in batches in the fat
Sauté onion and carrot, add garlic
Return beef, dust with flour, toss
Add wine, stock, bouquet garni
Braise 160°C oven 2.5 hours
Sauté pearl onions and mushrooms in butter, add last 30 min

l2m3n4o5.name: Tacos al Pastor
steps: Toast chilies, soak in hot water, blend with chipotles, spices, garlic, juice
Marinate pork 2+ hours
Sear pork on hot pan until crispy edges
Warm tortillas, fill with pork, pineapple, onion, cilantro
Squeeze lime
l2m3n4o5.notes: Char some pineapple alongside the pork.

m3n4o5p6.name: Mushroom Risotto
steps: Sauté mushrooms hot in olive oil, set aside
Sweat shallot in butter, add rice, toast 2 min
Deglaze with wine
Add stock a ladle at a time, stir until absorbed, 18-20 min
Stir in mushrooms, butter, parmesan
Rest 2 min covered, top with thyme
m3n4o5p6.notes: Stock must be hot or you'll shock the rice.

n4o5p6q7.name: Overnight Oats
steps: Combine oats, milk, chia, sweetener in a jar
Refrigerate overnight
Top with fruit and nuts in morning
n4o5p6q7.notes: Scale to a week's worth of jars.

o5p6q7r8.name: Kung Pao Chicken
ingredients: Sauce: 2 tbsp soy, 1 tbsp vinegar, 1 tbsp sugar, 1 tsp cornstarch
steps: Marinate chicken in soy and cornstarch 15 min
Heat oil, sizzle chilies and peppercorns 30 sec
Add chicken, stir-fry until cooked
Add garlic, ginger, spring onions
Pour sauce, toss until glossy
Stir in peanuts

p6q7r8s9.name: Lentil Dal
steps: Rinse lentils, cook in 600ml water 15 min until soft
Sauté onion until golden, add garlic, ginger, spices
Add tomatoes, simmer 5 min
Stir into lentils, add coconut milk if using
Simmer 10 min, top with cilantro

q7r8s9t0.name: Roast Chicken
steps: Pat chicken dry, salt generously, sit uncovered in fridge 1 hr+
Stuff cavity with lemon halves, garlic, herbs
Rub with butter and oil
Roast 200°C on bed of chopped root veg, 1 hr 15 min
Rest 15 min before carving

r8s9t0u1.name: Caprese Sandwich
steps: Slice ciabatta, toast lightly
Layer tomato, mozzarella, basil
Drizzle balsamic glaze and oil
Season with salt
r8s9t0u1.notes: Only makes sense with peak summer tomatoes.

s9t0u1v2.name: Bolognese
steps: Soffritto: sauté onion, carrot, celery 10 min
Add garlic, then mince, brown well
Add milk, simmer until evaporated
Add wine, reduce
Add tomatoes and parmesan rind, simmer uncovered 2-3 hours
Toss with tagliatelle and parmesan
s9t0u1v2.notes: The milk trick makes it silky.

t0u1v2w3.name: Sheet Pan Fajitas
ingredients: 2 tsp cumin, 2 tsp paprika, 1 tsp chili powder, garlic powder, salt
Flour tortillas, lime, sour cream, guac
steps: Toss meat and veg with oil and spices on sheet pan
Roast 220°C for 20 min, tossing halfway
Warm tortillas
Serve with lime, sour cream, guac

u1v2w3x4.name: French Onion Soup
steps: Caramelize onions in butter and sugar over low heat — 45 min, don't rush
Deglaze with wine, reduce
Add stock and thyme, simmer 20 min
Ladle into oven-safe bowls
Top with bread and gruyère
Broil until bubbly and golden
u1v2w3x4.notes: The long caramelization is the whole point — no shortcuts.

v2w3x4y5.name: Smashed Chickpea Salad
steps: Drain chickpeas, smash roughly with fork
Mix with mayo, Dijon, lemon
Stir in celery, onion, herbs
Season, serve on toast or in lettuce

w3x4y5z6.name: Gnocchi al Pomodoro
steps: Crush garlic, sizzle in oil on low 2 min
Add tomatoes, crush with spoon, simmer 15 min
Season, tear in basil
Meanwhile, boil gnocchi until they float (2-3 min)
Toss in sauce, top with parmesan
w3x4y5z6.notes: San Marzano tomatoes make a big difference.

x4y5z6a7.name: Banana Pancakes
steps: Mash bananas, whisk in eggs and milk
Fold in flour, baking powder, sugar, salt
Melt butter in pan on medium
Dollop batter, flip when bubbles form (2 min per side)
Serve with maple syrup

y5z6a7b8.name: Crispy Tofu Stir-Fry
ingredients: Sauce: 3 tbsp soy, 1 tbsp sesame oil, 1 tbsp honey, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 tsp cornstarch
steps: Cube tofu, toss in cornstarch
Fry in oil until golden on all sides, set aside
Stir-fry broccoli and pepper 3 min
Add garlic and ginger 30 sec
Return tofu, pour sauce, toss until glossy
Top with sesame, serve over rice
y5z6a7b8.notes: Press tofu at least 20 min for crispy results.

z6a7b8c9.name: Chocolate Chip Cookies
steps: Brown butter, cool slightly
Whisk with sugars, eggs, vanilla
Fold in flour, soda, salt, then chunks
Chill dough 30 min (or overnight)
Scoop onto tray, bake 180°C 10-12 min
Cool on tray 5 min
z6a7b8c9.notes: Brown butter is the secret. Underbake slightly for chewy.
